title: Members want an open training day
text: The fans would love it. The coaches would rather work.

choices.label: Open the doors
choices.result: The members loved it.

choices.label: Closed session
choices.result: A closed session. The coaches got their work done.

title: Members want a signing session after training
text: An hour in the car park with the members, after a long session.

choices.label: Stay back and sign
choices.result: The players sign for an hour.

choices.label: Not this week
choices.result: The signing session is put off.

title: The members are letting the club know
text: Letters, emails, a talkback storm. They want to hear from you.

choices.label: Front a members' forum
choices.result: You front the members on Tuesday night.

choices.label: Let the results answer

effects.why: You let the club answer with its football

choices.result: You stay at the club.

title: The cheer squad have asked for {name}
text: They want him to help paint the banner.

choices.label: Send him
choices.result: {name} helps paint the banner.

choices.label: Not this week
choices.result: The banner gets painted without him.

title: Members can't get finals tickets
text: The ticketing has been a mess, and the members are blaming the club.

choices.label: Front the media for the club
choices.result: You take the questions.

choices.label: Leave it to the CEO
choices.result: The CEO handles it.

title: Members are travelling to see you play
text: Two hundred of them on the trip, and they'd love to meet the players.

choices.label: Players meet them at the hotel
choices.result: The players spend an hour with the travelling members.

choices.label: Keep the players in their bubble
choices.result: The players stay in.

title: We're in
text: It's mathematical now: we can't drop out of the ten. The club's been buzzing all weekend.

choices.label: Let them enjoy tonight
choices.result: A few quiet ones at the club. They turn up on Monday walking taller.

choices.label: Nothing's won yet
choices.result: No celebrations. Recovery at seven on Monday, and a hard week after it.

title: {name}'s {milestone_next}th game is a Grand Final
text: Most players never get a milestone like it. The cheer squad want his name on the banner.

choices.label: His name goes on the banner

effects.why: You let the cheer squad put his name on the Grand Final banner

choices.result: His name runs across the bottom of the banner. He'll keep a piece of it forever.

choices.label: The banner is for the club

effects.why: You kept Grand Final week about the club

choices.result: The banner is all club. His milestone gets its moment after the siren.

title: Open training for the members
text: The club wants to open a session to the members before Round 1.

choices.label: Open the gates

effects.why: A pre-season session played to the crowd

choices.result: A few thousand members line the fence, and the session is a light one.

choices.label: Keep it closed

effects.why: A full pre-season session behind closed gates

choices.result: A full session behind closed gates. The members hear about it.

title: Our first final since {last_final_year}
text: The queue for tickets runs round the block. The players can hear the supporters from the track.

choices.label: Let the players feel it

effects.why: The players shared the first final in years with the supporters

choices.result: The players walk the queue after training, signing whatever's handed to them.

choices.label: Keep the noise outside

effects.why: You kept the first final in years a week like any other

choices.result: Same drills, same meetings, same Thursday. The doors stay shut.

choices.label: Celebrate it properly

effects.why: You let the premiership players celebrate it properly

choices.result: The celebrations run for a week.

choices.label: One week, then go again

effects.why: One week of celebrations, then you set the next target

choices.result: One week, then the talk turns to doing it again.
